description: The $MERCA a wallet has locked in the factor registry, how much counts for its tier (locked, no unlock requested), when a requested unlock is ready, and its Mercatura Pay tier (pay: its daily caps as a payer and a merchant). A wallet balance never counts. Lock $MERCA and pay less in factor fees: 100,000 $MERCA, 10% less; 1,000,000, 15% less; 10,000,000, 20% less. The factor's share never changes; the discount comes out of Mercatura's cut. Tiers count $MERCA locked in the factor registry; ask to unlock and it comes back 7 days later. These are the launch numbers; Mercatura can change them. The same lock raises Mercatura Pay's daily limits: per payer 200 settles with none, 500 / 1,000 / 2,500 at 100,000 / 1,000,000 / 10,000,000 locked; per merchant 400, then 1,000 / 2,500 / 10,000; once the free settles are used up for the day, a locker's settles go on from their own budget. A pay account counts its current owner's lock. Half of the factor fees Mercatura earns buys $MERCA once it reaches $5 and burns it to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD.
name: merca_lock_status
title: $MERCA: what a wallet has locked
